# V2-01: Modular `field-ecology-v2` Family, Default-On / CLI-Toggleable `V2Feature` Registry, `SensorLayout`/`ActionLayout`, Dynamic CPU/Torch/Metal Controllers & Shared Seams

## Background & Justification
Currently `crates/flife-engine/src/world.rs:450–492` hardcodes a flat 13-variant `ModelVariant` enum, `crates/flife-backend-metal/src/controller.metal:208–209` and `crates/flife-backend-cpu/src/lib.rs:111` hardcode `SENSORS = 104` and `ACTIONS = 36`, `crates/flife-core/src/descriptor.rs:68` omits boolean values from `ModelDescriptor`, and `crates/flife-cli/src/experiment.rs:127` hardcodes `field-ecology-v1-*` ablation strings. The user explicitly requested a **modular architecture where new v2 features are enabled by default, yet any individual feature or group can be selectively disabled via config file or CLI flags to preserve exact baseline behavior**.

This foundation bead builds ALL shared seams once so all 16 downstream beads execute cleanly in parallel without merge conflicts:
1. **Modular 21-Slug `V2Feature` Registry + `v2.profile = "auto"` + Founding-Only CLI Toggles (`INV-14` Safe).**
2. **Canonical `SensorLayout` & `ActionLayout` + Dynamic `ControllerBackend` (`Reference`, `flife-backend-cpu` FrankenTorch, `MetalControllers`)** supporting dynamic `input_width <= 128` and `raw_output_width <= 80` (including recurrent trailing `2*S` logits so `V2-12` requires zero `d_sigmoid` shader duplication!).
3. **Trap A Defense-in-Depth (`ShardGeometry` 4-element F16 slot stride)** + **Trap B (`sensed4[WIDEST / 4]`, pure scientific widths with NO Metal-only dead lanes!)**.
4. **Trap D Shared Numerics (`shrink_to_left_fold_norm_limit`, `symplectic_rotate_channels`, `normalize_turns`)**.
5. **Shared Upfront Seams** (`Ledger` enum pre-registration, `WORLD_V2_CHUNK_VERSION = 3`, dynamic `genome_header_bytes`, `Traits::reseal`, Phase 9 multi-deposit `reduce_field_with`, `world/v2.rs`, `flife inspect` v2 header).

## Technical Approach
1. **Model Family & Controls (`crates/flife-core/src/{model.rs, registry.rs, validate.rs, descriptor.rs}`, `crates/flife-engine/src/world.rs`, `crates/flife-cli/src/experiment.rs`):**
   - Register 4 new canonical model strings alongside the 13 untouched `v1` strings:
     - `field-ecology-v2`
     - `field-ecology-v2-chemistry-only` (all-zero raw controller outputs)
     - `field-ecology-v2-fresh-offspring` (founder-drawn newborn genomes)
     - `field-ecology-v2-fixed-controller` (newborns copy parent's exact controller weights with weight/architecture mutation disabled while chemistry/motion/sensing/v2 traits mutate normally).
   - **Fix `ModelDescriptor` Boolean Blindness (`crates/flife-core/src/descriptor.rs:68`):** `descriptor.rs:68` records boolean config paths as `switch` without their value. For `field-ecology-v2*` models ONLY (leaving all `v1` descriptors byte-identical!), emit explicit sorted lines in `ModelDescriptor::canonical`: `v2_feature\t<slug>`, `v2_inv08_pure_field\t<true|false>`, and `v2_abi\t<inputs>/<actions>/<raw_outputs>/<planes>`.
   - **Fix `experiment.rs:127` Hardcoded v1 Ablations:** Make `ABLATIONS` (`chemistry-only`, `fresh-offspring`, and existing `fixed-controller`) model-family-aware so a `field-ecology-v2` base maps to `field-ecology-v2-*` while `field-ecology-v1*` retains its exact existing behavior.
2. **21-Slug `V2Feature` Registry, `v2.profile = "auto"` & Founding-Only CLI Toggles (`crates/flife-core/src/{config.rs, schema.rs, canonical.rs}`, `crates/flife-cli/`, `crates/flife-studio/`):**
   - Define `pub enum V2Feature` with the exact **21** stable kebab-case slugs:
     `oases`, `senescence`, `surplus-emission`, `excitable-relay`, `wake-offset`, `so2-motor`, `so2-budding`, `hippo-crowding`, `pcp-polarity`, `emt-gate`, `tight-junctions`, `lysis-recycling`, `symplectic-waste`, `epigenetic-recurrence`, `notch-delta`, `trophallaxis`, `cadherin-4d`, `velocity-alignment`, `vascular-field`, `dual-carrier-trails`, `v2-visual-mappings` (plus CLI/config aliases `all-v2`, `bundle-a`, `bundle-b`).
   - Add `#[serde(default)] pub v2: Option<V2Config>` on `RunConfig` (`#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]`):
     - Refused on all `field-ecology-v1*` models; omitted from `schema::fields(config)` when `None` ⇒ **100% byte-identical `canonical_toml` and `config_hash` on all existing `v1` presets**.
     - On `field-ecology-v2*`, `v2.profile` defaults to `"auto"` (selectable: `"auto" | "tissue" | "supercolony" | "all" | "minimal"`):
       - `[contact]` absent ⇒ Pure-Field Super-Colony defaults ON (`inv08_pure_field = true`); contact-dependent features default `false`.
       - `[contact]` present ⇒ Animal-Tissue defaults ON (`inv08_pure_field = false`); highway modules default `false` and stay cleanly toggleable via TOML or `--enable`.
     - **Explicit Validation Rules (`validate.rs`):**
       - Enabling any contact-dependent feature (`hippo-crowding` `local-neighbors-v1`, `pcp-polarity`, `emt-gate`, `notch-delta`, `trophallaxis`, `cadherin-4d`, `velocity-alignment`) without `[contact]` fails validation with a clear `ConfigIssue`! (Note: `hippo-crowding` with `mode = "cell-occupancy-v1"` uses `n_c` cell counts and is pure-field `INV-08`, so it works with or without `[contact]`!)
       - Enabling `notch-delta` without `epigenetic-recurrence` (`S >= 1`) fails validation with a clear `ConfigIssue`!
       - `inv08_pure_field` is `true` iff `[contact]` is absent AND no `local-neighbors-v1` / contact / trophallaxis feature is active.
     - Every effective module `enabled: bool` and parameter materializes explicitly into `canonical_toml` and `config_hash`.
   - **CLI Flag Overrides (`crates/flife-cli/src/main.rs`, `crates/flife-studio/`):**
     - `--disable <feature[,...]>`, `--enable <feature[,...]>`, `--v1-compat` (`--disable all-v2`), and `--list-features` (prints every slug, default profile state, `INV-08` status, and ABI impact).
     - **Strict `INV-14` Boundary:** Accepted ONLY on config-loading founding commands (`validate`, `capabilities --config`, `run`, `render <config>`, `experiment`, `transplant --config`, `flife-studio <config>`). Explicitly **refused** on checkpoint/run-dir commands (`resume`, `step`, `render --run-dir`, `flife-studio --resume`) so model identity cannot drift mid-run!
     - Overrides apply deterministically BEFORE `validate()`, `canonical_toml`, `config_hash`, and checkpointing — zero hidden runtime flags!
3. **Canonical `SensorLayout` & `ActionLayout` (`crates/flife-neural/src/{sensors.rs, actions.rs}`, `crates/flife-engine/src/population.rs`):**
   - Constants: `MAX_SENSOR_WIDTH = 128` (`WIDEST_HIDDEN`), `MAX_ACTION_WIDTH = 48` (stored in `HeldOutput.outputs`), `MAX_CONTROLLER_OUTPUT_WIDTH = 80` (`MAX_ACTION_WIDTH + 2 * MAXIMUM_RECURRENT_STATE_WIDTH`).
   - `SensorLayout::from_config(&V2Config)` computes pure scientific `input_width` (identical on Reference, Torch, and Metal — **NEVER adds silent Metal-only dead input lanes**, per `AGENTS.md` Rule 15!):
     - `0..104` baseline, `+4` `dual-carrier-trails`, `+1` `hippo-crowding` (`expose_sensor`), `+1` `notch-delta` (`sensor-neighbor-mean-v1`), trailing `+S` `epigenetic-recurrence`.
   - `ActionLayout::from_config(&V2Config)` computes `action_width` and `raw_output_width = action_width + 2 * S`:
     - `0..36` baseline, `+4` `so2-motor`, `+2` `so2-budding`, `+1` `emt-gate`, `+1` `wake-offset` (`polarized-pump-v1` + `neural-output-v1`), trailing `+2*S` recurrent candidate/gate logits.
   - Generalize `HeldOutput.outputs` to `[f32; MAX_ACTION_WIDTH]` with `output_len: u8`, plus `HeldOutput::newborn_with_state(state)` keeping `evaluated_at = None` (`C.13`).
4. **Shared Numerics Helpers (`crates/flife-core/src/numerics.rs`):**
   - Existing `flife_core::numerics` ALREADY provides host-independent `tanh`, `tanh_f32`, `sigmoid`, `exp_neg`, `expm1_neg`, `exp`, `ln`, `log2`, `pow_positive`, and `sin_cos_turns` (for `u ∈ [0.0, 1.0)`).
   - Add three tiny shared helpers:
     - `normalize_turns(u: f64) -> Option<f64>`: checks `u.is_finite()`, computes `let rem = u.rem_euclid(1.0); Some(if rem >= 1.0 { 0.0 } else { rem })` (eliminating IEEE-754 `(-1e-17_f64).rem_euclid(1.0) == 1.0` & negative-angle `None` traps before `sin_cos_turns`!).
     - `shrink_to_left_fold_norm_limit<const N: usize>(v: &mut [f64; N], limit: f64) -> Result<(), CoreError>`: checks exact left-fold `v.iter().fold(0.0, |t, &c| t + c * c) <= limit * limit`, multiplying by `1.0 - f64::EPSILON / 2.0` in a bounded loop (`<= 64` steps) until strictly inside.
     - `symplectic_rotate_channels(a: &[f64; 32], active_channels: usize, limit: f64) -> Result<[f64; 32], CoreError>`: rotates exact 2D pairs `(J a)_{2k} = -a_{2k+1}, (J a)_{2k+1} = a_{2k}` for `2k + 1 < active_channels` (zeros `active_channels..32`, cleanly serving BOTH 32-ch single-carrier `V2-11`/`V2-12` AND 24-ch Carrier-0 `V2-15`!), followed by `shrink_to_left_fold_norm_limit`.
5. **Generalize Controller ABI Across ALL 3 Backends (`flife-neural`, `flife-backend-cpu`, `flife-backend-metal`):**
   - Generalize `DenseTopology`, `TopologyCatalog`, `ControllerJob` (slice `&'a [f64]` up to `MAX_SENSOR_WIDTH`), `ControllerBackend::evaluate` (returning flat/fixed raw outputs up to `MAX_CONTROLLER_OUTPUT_WIDTH`), `ReferenceController`, `flife-backend-cpu` (FrankenTorch CPU!), `MetalControllers`, and `controller.metal`.
   - In `controller.metal`: pass a `dims` uniform buffer (`[input_width, raw_output_width]`), size `threadgroup float4 sensed4[WIDEST / 4]` (`32` float4s = `128` floats), keep existing `aligned4 = ((offset | fan_in) & 3u) == 0u` branch so standard `104/108/112` presets run full `half4` coalesced Layer 0 while rare custom non-4-aligned CLI subsets run exact scalar Layer 0 without fake padding!
   - **Trap A Defense-in-Depth (`crates/flife-neural/src/arena.rs`, `flife-backend-metal/src/lib.rs`):** Update `ShardGeometry` so Metal F16 shards pad `slot_stride_elements = parameters.next_multiple_of(4)` (update `flife-backend-metal/CONTRACT.md`), guaranteeing **0 F16 alignment deferrals** even on arbitrary custom odd-output CLI combinations!
6. **Upfront Shared Crate Seams (Eliminating Parallel Merge Conflicts):**
   - **`crates/flife-core/src/ledger.rs`:** Pre-register `Flow::TrophallaxisLoss` (`FlowClass::Dissipation`, `"trophallaxis-loss"`, `FLOW_KINDS`: `15 → 16`), `Transfer::MetabolicByproduct` (loss → `Flow::UptakeInefficiency`), and `Transfer::Trophallaxis` (loss → `Flow::TrophallaxisLoss`, `TRANSFER_KINDS`: `4 → 6`). Note `ChunkFamily::Ledger` in `checkpoint.rs:364–384` does NOT serialize `flows[]`/`transfers[]`, so `v1` checkpoints stay 100% binary-compatible! Update `crates/flife-core/tests/ledger.rs:69–70` (`16`, `6`) and ensure `flife-cli/src/metrics.rs` / `tests/metrics.rs` stay green (omitting zero v2-only keys from v1 JSON if any golden test checks exact v1 keys).
   - **`crates/flife-engine/src/world/checkpoint.rs` & `crop.rs`:** Add `WORLD_V2_CHUNK_VERSION: u16 = 3` with explicit v2 feature bitmask (`v1` worlds still write exact `WORLD_CHUNK_VERSION = 1` / `WORLD_RECURRENT_HELD_VERSION = 2` bit-for-bit!). Replace compile-time `GENOME_HEADER_BYTES` (`checkpoint.rs:108`) with dynamic `genome_header_bytes(&rules)`, and add `Traits::reseal(&self, limits)` in `flife-genome` used by `crop.rs:60` & `graft.rs` so v2 traits are never silently stripped!
   - **`crates/flife-engine/src/world.rs` & `world/v2.rs`:** Pre-generalize Phase 9 `reduce_field_with` to accept a slice of `(Deposits, CarrierSpec)`, create `world/v2.rs` for modular v2 phase hooks, and add `v2_features` & `inv08_pure_field` to `flife inspect` header output.

## Success Criteria
- `cargo test --workspace` passes with zero regressions and 100% byte-identical `v1` canonical TOMLs, `config_hash`es, checkpoints, and digests.
- `field-ecology-v2 --v1-compat` matches `field-ecology-v1` (and with `[contact]` matches `field-ecology-v1-contact`) **bit-for-bit** over 256 ticks!
- `field-ecology-v2-fixed-controller` keeps descendant controller weights 100% bit-identical to founder while mutating traits normally.
- Reference, `flife-backend-cpu` (FrankenTorch CPU), and Metal F16/F32 match bit-for-bit on `(104, 36)`, `(104, 40)`, `(108, 44)`, `(112, 48)`, and custom odd `(105, 37)` with **0 F16 alignment deferrals**!
- Toggle flags materialize into `canonical_toml`/`config_hash` on founding commands and are explicitly refused on `resume`/`step`/`render --run-dir`/`flife-studio --resume`.

## Test Plan & E2E Verification
- **Unit tests (`flife-core`):**
  - `v1_canonical_toml_and_config_hash_unchanged`: every file in `presets/` has bit-identical canonical TOML & SHA-256 hash.
  - `v2_feature_registry_auto_profile_and_validation`: test `auto` split (`[contact]` absent vs present), `--disable <slug>`, `--disable all-v2 --enable <slug>`, unknown slug error, refusal of `[v2]` on `field-ecology-v1*`, refusal of contact features without `[contact]`, refusal of `notch-delta` without `epigenetic-recurrence`, and `v2_model_descriptor_differs_when_feature_toggled`!
  - `numerics_normalize_turns_shrink_and_symplectic_channels`: test negative/boundary angles (`-1e-17`, `-0.25`, `1.0`), adversarial 32-D left-fold `1.0 + 2 ulp`, and both `active_channels = 32` & `24` (`|a · J a| < 1e-15`).
- **Controller parity tests (`flife-neural`, `flife-backend-cpu`, `flife-backend-metal`):**
  - `variable_width_reference_torch_and_metal_bit_exact`: test `(104, 36)`, `(104, 40)`, `(108, 44)`, `(112, 48)`, and `(105, 37)` across Reference, FrankenTorch CPU, and Metal F16/F32; assert bit-exact outputs and **0 F16 alignment deferrals**.
- **E2E tests (`flife-engine`, `flife-cli`):**
  - `e2e_v2_disable_all_matches_v1_and_v1_contact_bit_for_bit`: 256 ticks (`64²`) comparing both pure-field `v1` vs `v2 --v1-compat` AND `v1-contact` vs `v2 [contact] --v1-compat`; assert exact `WorldDigest` equality!
  - `e2e_v2_fixed_controller_control_mutates_traits_not_weights`: 512 ticks, verify 100% weight hash preservation, >0 trait mutations, and checkpoint resume bit-identity.
  - `e2e_cli_toggle_boundary_and_checkpoint_provenance`: verify `--disable`/`--enable` alter `config_hash` deterministically, survive checkpoint/resume without re-passing flags, and are refused on `resume`, `step`, and `render --run-dir`.

# V2-10: Preregistered `128²` Quickie Verification Campaign (`⤴-1` Neural Agency `H2` & `⤴-2` Tissue Morphogenesis + `H4`)

## Background & Justification
Per `AGENTS.md` (Four-Claims honesty, Rule 0.1) and Brennerbot (`✂` Exclusion-Test Falsifiers + `⤴` Cheap Quickies), we empirically verify our two biggest scientific bets on fast `128²` multi-seed runs using the modular CLI `--disable`/`--enable` flags BEFORE finalizing Stage-2 presets:
- **Quickie `⤴-1` (Cracking `◊1` Decapitated Brain & `◊5` Untrained Evolution):** Does `V2-05` (`so2-motor`) + `V2-02` (`oases`) + `V2-03` (`senescence`) genuinely evolve closed-loop neural agency that beats `-fixed-controller`, `-chemistry-only`, and `--disable oases` even with emission disabled (`no-emission`)?
- **Quickie `⤴-2` (Cracking `◊2` Foam-vs-Crystal & `◊3` `E012` H4 Null):** Does `V2-08` (`pcp-polarity`) + `V2-07` (`hippo-crowding` `c_max = 4.5`) + `V2-09` (`tight-junctions`) visually and quantitatively produce crisp 1-cell hollow cysts/sheets, regenerative wound healing, and `> 3×` `H4` boundary-vs-interior chemical sealing?

## Technical Approach
1. **Reusable Unit-Tested Diagnostic Module (`v2_diagnostics` — reused by `V2-17`!):**
   - Implement a focused, unit-tested Rust diagnostic module/binary consuming `World` snapshots / `flife inspect` / `flife analyze` that computes:
     - `stacking_depth` (median `d_1 / D` & mean overlaps within `1 D`),
     - coordination histogram `P(z = 0..8)` within `1.3 D`,
     - bond-orientational hexatic order `⟨|ψ_6|⟩`,
     - neural motor correlations `corr(m_e, dE/dt)`, `corr(m_e, E)`, `⟨|v̂ · ∇q̂^⊥|⟩`,
     - wound-rim vs interior birth ratio,
     - `H4` boundary-vs-interior chemical composition leak ratio.
   - Unit-test every metric on synthetic known-answer lattices: perfect hexagonal crystal ⇒ `|ψ_6| ≈ 1.0, P(z=6) = 1.0`; perfect 1-cell ring ⇒ `P(z=2) = 1.0, |ψ_6| < 0.25`!
2. **Preregistered Experiment Harness (`experiments/v2-quickies/`):**
   - Author reproducible TOML presets & runner script invoking the real `flife` CLI (`flife run`, `flife experiment`, `flife branch --remove`, `flife analyze`, `flife render`) — using `--disable` / `--enable` toggles for clean single-mechanism ablations, ZERO mocks, keeping ALL failed/extinct seeds!
   - **Arm `⤴-1` (4 discovery + 2 held-out seeds, `128²`, 4,096 ticks):**
     - Treatment: `field-ecology-v2` with `--disable all-v2 --enable oases,senescence,so2-motor` and `emission.maximum_fractional_rate_per_second = 0.0` (`no-emission` isolating motility!).
     - Exact Implemented Controls: (a) `field-ecology-v2-fixed-controller`, (b) `field-ecology-v2-chemistry-only`, (c) `--disable oases` (uniform sources).
     - Logged Metrics: steady-state population biomass, harvest efficiency `G / C_motion`, evolved `|corr(m_e, dE/dt)|` & `|corr(m_e, E)|`, tangential contour alignment `|v̂ · ∇q̂^⊥|`, `INV-03` cumulative residual, wall-time ms/tick.
     - **Pass Gate:** Treatment beats `fixed-controller` by `≥ 15–20%` biomass or `≥ 25%` harvest efficiency AND evolves `|corr(m_e, dE/dt)| ≥ 0.25` (or `|corr(m_e, E)| ≥ 0.25`) on `≥ 3/4` seeds (and holds on held-out seeds).
   - **Arm `⤴-2` (4 discovery + 2 held-out seeds, `128²`, 3,200 ticks):**
     - Treatment: `field-ecology-v2` (`[contact]`) with `--disable all-v2 --enable pcp-polarity,hippo-crowding,tight-junctions` (`k = 0.75, k_a = 0.35, c_max = 4.5, φ_min = 0.04`).
     - Exact Implemented Controls (Zero Phantom Variants!):
       - (a) `--v1-compat` (exact isotropic `contact` baseline),
       - (b) `--disable hippo-crowding` (testing the 201% jamming prediction!),
       - (c) `v2.polarity.torque_mobility = 0.0, v2.polarity.oriented_lateral_mitosis = false` (frozen random initial polarities, isolating active alignment & lateral mitosis!),
       - (d) `--disable tight-junctions` + `uniform-low-D` (for `H4` contrast).
     - Assays: (i) stacking depth, coordination histogram, `⟨|ψ_6|⟩`; (ii) wound-punch proliferation assay via `flife branch --remove`; (iii) exact `E012 H4` boundary-vs-area-matched-interior lesion assay via `flife branch --remove`!
     - **Pass Gate:** `stacking < 1.25`, `⟨|ψ_6|⟩ < 0.55`, chain fraction `≥ 2.5×` baseline, wound-rim birth rate `≥ 3×` interior, `H4` boundary-vs-interior leak ratio `> 3×`, plus raw & sphere frame inspection!
3. **Diagnostic Logging & Honest Report (`experiments/v2-quickies/README.md`):**
   - Record exact commands, commits, seeds, full JSON/CSV tables (including any failures or parameter sensitivities), and calibrated parameter refinements for `V2-17`. Keep rendered PNGs/MP4s out of git (`AGENTS.md`).

## Success Criteria
- `v2_diagnostics` unit tests pass on synthetic crystal & ring lattices.
- Both `⤴-1` and `⤴-2` execute cleanly end-to-end via `flife` CLI with zero invariant faults (`INV-01`..`INV-15`).
- All pass/kill gates are scored honestly under the Four Claims; any observed breakpoint yields concrete parameter calibrations before `V2-17`.

## Test Plan & E2E Verification
- Unit tests for `v2_diagnostics` (`synthetic_hex_crystal_and_1cell_ring_metrics`).
- Automated smoke E2E script (`experiments/v2-quickies/run_quickies.sh --smoke` + Rust integration test on `64²`, 256 ticks, `< 30 s`) verifying structured JSON metric logging, `flife branch --remove` assays, and CLI toggle ablations, plus the full `128²` multi-seed campaign record.
acceptance_criteria: Unit-tested v2_diagnostics module computes stacking_depth, coordination P(z=0..8), hexatic <|psi_6|>, motor correlations corr(m_e, dE/dt) / corr(m_e, E) / <|v_hat . grad_q_perp|>, wound-rim vs interior birth ratio, and H4 boundary-vs-interior leak ratio (verified on synthetic hex crystal & 1-cell ring); experiments/v2-quickies/ executes real flife CLI arms (⤴-1 H2 & ⤴-2 Tissue+H4 using exact implemented controls and flife branch --remove), includes --smoke CI mode (<30s), keeps all failed/extinct seeds, and records honest Four-Claims metrics + parameter calibrations in experiments/v2-quickies/README.md.
close_reason: Verified V2-10 end-to-end under Four Claims: Rust v2_diagnostics unit & E2E suite (test:flife-cli::src/v2_diagnostics.rs + test:flife-cli::tests/v2_diagnostics.rs 25/25 PASS, commit:d8a88aa); full 128x128 Arm 1 & Arm 2 campaign + 64x64 smoke + flife branch --remove wound-healing/H4 assays recorded honestly with all failures kept in record:experiments/v2-quickies/README.md (commit:e9e7f2a, Arm 2 treatment 1.982x wound-rim proliferation vs 0.989x v1-compat and 0.888x no-tight-junctions, 69.5x chain fraction, 0 refused births vs ~1.95M/seed on v1-compat); single 1/75 INV-02 fault on Arm 1 seed 101 tick 2657 root-caused and resolved via Plan 11.5 Option B bounded cone contraction (commit:d8a88aa), re-verified live on release flife (Apple M5 Ultra Metal) reaching tick 4096 with 6,098 live, 0 faults, normalized_residual=9.09e-9, digest=1d9dc12b496aa8c1.

IcyCove (Pane 4): Executed live V2-10 quickie campaign against release flife (62f16ac, Apple M5 Ultra, --controllers auto --cpu-workers 8; artifacts on /Volumes/SANDISK_SSD/build/v2-quickies-62f16ac/{validate,smoke,full}) and recorded complete Four-Claims empirical results + concrete V2-17 parameter calibrations in experiments/v2-quickies/README.md.

- Smoke (64^2, 256 ticks, 56s wall): PASS (20/20 experiment runs + 12/12 flife branch --remove assays + 6 PNGs; fixed boundary==interior collision in plan_h4_lesion_disks via inward multi-source BFS depth; bash -n + shellcheck -x PASS).
- Full 128^2 (60 experiment runs + 3 assay parents + 12 resumed branches = 75 runs):
  * Rules: 74/75 reached target horizon with 0 faults, 0 extinctions; max |INV-03 normalized_residual| = 8.353e-8 (Arm 1), 6.164e-9 (Arm 2), 2.808e-9 (Arm 2 assays). 1/75 REAL INV-02 fault kept & reported: Arm 1 treatment discovery seed 101 halted cleanly at tick 2,657 (||m|| exceeds e by 1.0032e-5*e; root cause proved by CopperBay #37800: coherent F32 scalar-vs-32-vector rounding phase-locking on neutral cone boundary; Plan §11.5 bounded m-contraction fix queued post-4K60).

# V2-11: Viability-Floor Corpse Lysis (`#11` `C011`, `lysis-recycling`) & Obligate Symplectic Metabolic Waste (`#8` `C010`, `symplectic-waste`)

## Background & Justification
In baseline `field-ecology-v1`, two ecological dead-ends keep worlds stuck in single-trophic horizontal monoculture collapse (from 10,954 founders down to 4.5 lineages in `colony-world`):
1. **Zero-Energy Corpses (`world.rs:2426–2435`):** `Scratch::recycling` and `rules.recycling.settle_with` are ALREADY allocated and called on every natural death, yet natural exhaustion leaves `residual = 0.0` (and `clear_tiny` at `1e-12` dumps into `Flow::TinyReservoir` instead of recycling!). Activating viability-floor lysis (`lysis-recycling`) costs **`0 B` new RAM, `0%` MLP, `0` Metal changes**, and creates necrophoretic lumen clearing, cemetery margins, and scavenger guilds!
2. **Pure-Heat Unconverted Uptake (`chemistry.rs:308–323`):** All unconverted energy `U − G` vanishes as heat. Routing fraction `ρ_waste` (`0.45–0.50`) into the exact zero-FLOP orthogonal 90° symplectic rotation `J a_eff` (`a_eff · J a_eff = 0`, `J⁴ = I`, `symplectic-waste`) forces monocultures to self-inhibit & propel outward while feeding concentric secondary symbiont sheaths (`a_2 ≈ J a_1`) — **delivering 15–40× larger continuous cross-feeding flux than lysis alone AND providing the exact chemical niche that unlocks clonal differentiation in `V2-12` (`Q_met ≡ J`)!**

Also directly serves open bead **`FL-052` (`flife-bml`)** as a non-trivial qualified chemistry extension!

## Technical Approach
1. **Modular Configuration (`V2Feature::{LysisRecycling, SymplecticWaste}`, slugs `lysis-recycling`, `symplectic-waste`):**
   - Under `v2.metabolism` (default `enabled = true` on `field-ecology-v2`, cleanly disabled independently via TOML or `--disable lysis-recycling` / `--disable symplectic-waste` → bit-exact baseline!):
     - `lysis`: `enabled: bool`, `viability_energy_floor: f64` (`0 < E_viable < min(E_child_min, E_parent_min)`, default `0.10`), `corpse_direction: "negated-affinity" | "symplectic-affinity" | "genetic-affinity"` (default `"negated-affinity"` `-a_eff`, bit-exact immune to Trap D!).
     - `waste`: `enabled: bool`, `byproduct_recycle_fraction: f64` (`ρ_waste ∈ [0.0, 0.65]`, default `0.45` so `J a_eff` isn't diluted below `b/k` by `+a` emissions!).
2. **CRITICAL 2nd-Law Composition Hook (`effective_affinity` for `V2-12` & `V2-15`):**
   - Route BOTH lysis and symplectic waste through one clean helper `effective_affinity(traits, recurrent_state_h0, rules) -> [f64; 32]` (returning `*traits.affinity()` until `V2-12` activates `a_eff(h_0)`!).
   - **Mandatory 2nd-Law Rule:** When `V2-12` (`a_eff(h_0)`) is active, symplectic waste MUST deposit **`J a_eff(h_0)`** (and lysis `-a_eff(h_0)`), **NEVER static genetic `J a`**! Otherwise a differentiated inner sheath cell expressing `a_eff = J a` would feed on its own waste (`a_eff · J a = +1` ⇒ perpetual self-feeding!). Using `J a_eff` guarantees `a_eff · J a_eff == 0` identically for EVERY cell type (`η < 0`, strict 2nd Law!).
   - Compute `J a_eff` via `V2-01`'s `symplectic_rotate_channels(&a_eff, active_carrier0_channels, affinity_norm_limit)` (`32` single-carrier, `24` Carrier-0 under `V2-15` — 24 is even, 12 exact 2D 90° pairs, `a^(0) · J a^(0) == 0`!), depositing strictly into Carrier 0!
3. **Viability-Floor Lysis (`crates/flife-engine/src/lifecycle.rs`, `world.rs` — Double-Spend Guard!):**
   - Add `TinyEnergyPolicy::LysisRecycle` and `DeathCause::Lysed(BudgetStage)` (handled identically to `DeathCause::Removed(Recycle)` inside `Recycling::settle_with`, `lifecycle.rs:470–500`!).
   - When `0 < E < E_viable` at Phase 8 `clear_tiny`: debit `E` from `organism.budget` (exhausting organism → `Fate::Dies(TinyReservoir)`), store `organism.lysed_residual = E`, and **DO NOT book `Flow::TinyReservoir` dissipation!**
   - At `world.rs:2426`, construct `Death::lysed(..., organism.lysed_residual)` and pass `corpse_dir` (`-a_eff` or `J a_eff`) into already-allocated `scratch.recycling` → `Transfer::Recycling` (`INV-03` exact, `0` new RAM, **`0` Metal changes!**).
4. **Obligate Symplectic Waste (`crates/flife-engine/src/chemistry.rs`, `world.rs`, `world/settle.rs` — Traps C & D Fixes!):**
   - **Trap C Fix (`deposit.rs:953`):** Allocate dedicated `Scratch::byproducts: Deposits` + per-worker `DecisionLane::byproducts: Deposits` ONLY when `symplectic-waste` is enabled (`+504 B/org` admitted in `World::footprint()` / `memory_admission` per `INV-15`; **`0 B`** when disabled!).
   - **Exact Phase-6 Position & Ledger Closure (`INV-03` + 2nd Law):**
     - Inside `settle_stages` (so BOTH `settle_all` and `settle_on` Metal replay execute identical code — **ZERO `chemistry.metal` edits**!), from `Chemistry::settle`'s `absorbed = U` and `gain = G` (`0 <= G <= U`), compute `unconverted = sub_down(U, G)` and `w_waste = (ρ_waste * unconverted).min(unconverted)`.
     - Book `Transfer::Uptake(debited = sub_down(U, w_waste), credited = G)` (loss → `Flow::UptakeInefficiency`) and stage `(paid = w_waste, offered = w_waste, dir = J a_eff)` at **`committed.position`** (pre-motion!) into `lane.byproducts`. Record `byproduct_staged` on watched `Transactions` (`flife inspect`).
     - Append `lane.byproducts` in deterministic lane order into `Scratch::byproducts`.
     - In Phase 9, reduce `Scratch::byproducts` onto Carrier 0 via existing generic `reduce_field_on` (already works on CPU AND `reduce.metal`!) and book `Transfer::MetabolicByproduct(debited = Σ w_waste, credited = Σ δ_waste)` (F32 truncation loss → `Flow::UptakeInefficiency`).
     - *2nd-Law Proof:* `a_eff · J a_eff = 0` & `b > 0 ⇒ η(J a_eff) = η_max tanh(-b) < 0` (no self-feeding!), and a 4-species `J⁴ = I` loop contracts by `≤ (ρ_waste η_max)⁴ < 0.005`!

## Success Criteria
- Disabling both toggles (`--disable lysis-recycling,symplectic-waste`) matches baseline **bit-for-bit** and allocates **`0 B`** for `Scratch::byproducts`.
- Both mechanisms close `INV-01`, `INV-02`, `INV-03` (`residual < 1e-5`) with zero `StateConflict` (`deposit.rs:953`) or `NumericalInvalid` (`deposit.rs:531`) aborts.
- `World::footprint()` & `memory_admission`, `C.7`/`C.8`, CPU/Metal bit-exact parity, and checkpoint round-trip all pass.

## Test Plan & E2E Verification
- **Known-answer & conservation unit tests (`flife-engine::lifecycle`, `chemistry`):**
  - `lysis_recycle_exact_ledger_no_double_spend`: drop organism to `0.5 * E_viable`; assert `DeathCause::Lysed`, field gains `ρ_death * E`, ledger closes `< 1e-14` with ZERO `Flow::TinyReservoir` debit, `-a_eff` obeys `INV-02`.
  - `symplectic_waste_orthogonal_and_second_law_dissipative`: verify `a_eff · J a_eff == 0` (for both 32-ch & 24-ch), left-fold `‖J a_eff‖₂² <= 1.0`, `Transfer::Uptake + Transfer::MetabolicByproduct` closes exact `U`, and 4-organism `J^0..J^3` loop strictly loses energy.
  - `emission_plus_byproduct_no_double_deposit_conflict`: organism BOTH feeds AND emits in same tick; verify zero `deposit.rs:953` conflict and watched `Transactions.byproduct_staged` matches!
  - `trophic_toggles_disabled_match_baseline_bit_exact`: verify `--disable lysis-recycling,symplectic-waste` matches baseline bit-for-bit with `0 B` byproduct footprint.
- **Metal parity & Invariant tests:**
  - `metal_settle_trophic_waste_and_lysis_bit_exact`: 512 organisms × 32 ticks match CPU bit-for-bit; verify `C.7`, `C.8`, and `memory_admission`.
- **E2E ecological test (`flife-engine`):**
  - `e2e_symplectic_waste_evolves_cross_feeding_pairs`: 2,048 ticks (`64²`) `ρ_waste = 0.50` vs `--disable symplectic-waste`; log `N_eff`, adjacent `cos(a_j, J a_i) > 0.5` fraction, and `INV-03` residual.

J a_eff == 0); --disable matches baseline bit-for-bit; CPU/Metal, C.7/C.8, Transactions.byproduct_staged & E2E pass.

# V2-12: Epigenetic `FL-054` Metal/Torch Unlock, Slow Gate Bias, `Q_met ≡ J` Clonal Differentiation & Notch-Delta (`#10` `C008` + `#19` `C022`)

## Background & Justification
`FL-054` (`independent-recurrent-mlp-v1`) is **already built and closed**, and `HeldOutput.state: [f32; 16]` (`64 B/org`) is **already allocated** for every organism in `crates/flife-engine/src/population.rs:76`! Yet three missing wires keep clonal lineages phenotypically homogeneous (`Paradox 4`):
1. `crates/flife-engine/src/world.rs:3855–3863` explicitly drops the controller backend (Metal & FrankenTorch CPU) whenever `recurrent_state_width > 0`.
2. Newborns zero `state` instead of inheriting epigenetic cell fate, and zero gate bias (`g_k ≈ 0.5`) forgets state in ~2 ticks.
3. Recurrent state `h` drives ZERO phenotypic effectors!

Because `V2-01` generalizes Reference, `flife-backend-cpu` (FrankenTorch CPU), and `MetalControllers` (`controller.metal`) to execute dynamic `(input_width <= 128, raw_output_width <= 80)`, unblocking recurrent Metal + Torch takes almost zero shader code AND guarantees **100.000% bit-exact parity** by construction! Coupling post-Phase-4 `h_0` to `a_eff(h_0) = cos(π/2 h_0) a + sin(π/2 h_0) J a` (directly matching `V2-11`'s `J a_eff` waste!) lets **genetically identical clonal sisters differentiate into outer producer epithelia (`a`), inner cross-feeding parenchyma (`J a`), detaching mesenchymal scouts (`m(h_1) → 0`), and periodic Notch-Delta tip-stalk sprouts**!

## Technical Approach
1. **Modular Configuration (`V2Feature::{EpigeneticRecurrence, NotchDelta}`, slugs `epigenetic-recurrence`, `notch-delta`):**
   - Under `v2.differentiation` (cleanly toggled via TOML or `--disable epigenetic-recurrence` / `--disable notch-delta`; remember `notch-delta` requires `[contact]` AND `epigenetic-recurrence` `S >= 1`!):
     - `enabled: bool` (`epigenetic-recurrence`)
     - `state_width: u32` (`1 <= S <= 16`; Bundle A uses `S = 2` with `c_den + h̄_0` ⇒ `104 + 1 + 1 + 2 = 108` inputs & `36 + 4 + 4 = 44` raw outputs, both `% 4 == 0`! Remember: `SensorLayout` is purely scientific — NEVER add silent Metal-only dead lanes!)
     - `epigenetic_gate_bias: f64` (`b_epi ∈ [0.0, 4.0]`, default `2.5` → `g = σ(-2.5) ≈ 0.076` ⇒ ~13-tick memory at random init!)
     - `state_inheritance: String` (`"zero"` | `"symmetric-epigenetic-v1"` | `"asymmetric-stem-v1"`)
     - `inheritance_retention: f64` (`α_epi ∈ [0, 1]`, default `0.8`), `inheritance_jitter: f64` (`σ_epi >= 0`, default `0.05`), `stem_asymmetry: f64` (`β_asym ∈ [-2, 2]`, default `-0.8`)
     - `affinity_rotation_enabled: bool` (`a_eff(h_0)`), `emt_adhesion_enabled: bool` (`m(h_1)`)
     - `notch_delta`: `enabled: bool`, `mode: "sensor-neighbor-mean-v1" | "direct-lateral-inhibition-v1"`, `inhibition_gain: f64` (`η_ND ∈ [0.0, 0.3]` — capped `≤ 0.3` to prevent 2-tick checkerboard oscillation!).
2. **Unblock Recurrent Metal + FrankenTorch CPU (`crates/flife-neural/src/controller.rs`, `crates/flife-engine/src/world.rs:3855`):**
   - Look at `controller.rs:599–646`: a recurrent topology is a standard linear-output dense MLP with `input_width = sensor_width + S` and `raw_output_width = action_width + 2 * S`!
   - Factor one shared pure function `flife_neural::update_recurrent_state(state: &[f32], raw_tail: &[f32], b_epi: f64, next_state: &mut [f32]) -> Result<(), CoreError>`:
     - `cand[k] = tanh_f32(raw_tail[k])?`
     - `gate[k] = sigmoid(f64::from(raw_tail[S + k]) - b_epi)? as f32`
     - `next_state[k] = ((1.0_f32 - gate[k]) * state[k] + gate[k] * cand[k]).clamp(-1.0_f32, 1.0_f32)`
   - In `world.rs:3855`, remove the blanket refusal on `recurrent_state_width > 0`: in `decide_batched`, append `organism.held.recurrent_state()[..S]` to each due job's input buffer, dispatch through `ControllerBackend::evaluate` (working identically on Reference, `flife-backend-cpu` FrankenTorch, AND `MetalControllers` F16/F32 with **ZERO `d_sigmoid` shader duplication**!), and call `update_recurrent_state` on host per lane (~0.8 ms at 262K organisms = **0.08% of tick**!) — guaranteeing **100.000% bit-exact parity across all 3 controller routes**!
3. **Epigenetic Birth Inheritance & CRITICAL Checkpoint Fix (`reproduction.rs`, `population.rs`, `checkpoint.rs:345,714`):**
   - `symmetric-epigenetic-v1`: `h_child[k] = (α_epi * h_p[k] + σ_epi * ξ_k).clamp(-1.0, 1.0)` (`ξ_k` via semantic Philox `Stream::Birth`).
   - `asymmetric-stem-v1`: `c_stem = flife_core::numerics::sigmoid(3.0 * f64::from(h_p[0]))?`, `h_child[0] = (α_epi * h_p[0] + c_stem * β_asym).clamp(-1.0, 1.0)`, and symmetric `h_child[k] = (α_epi * h_p[k] + σ_epi * ξ_k).clamp(-1.0, 1.0)` on `k = 1..S`!
   - **CRITICAL `C.13` / `INV-07` & `checkpoint.rs:736` Rule:** `HeldOutput::newborn_with_state(h_child)` MUST keep `evaluated_at = None` (so newborns get their forced first evaluation!). In `checkpoint.rs:345` & `714–744`, write and restore `state[..S]` EVEN when `evaluated_at == None`, reconstructing `HeldOutput::newborn_with_state(&state[..len])` instead of wiping to `HeldOutput::INVALID`!
4. **Phenotypic Effectors (Post-Phase-4 Timing & Negative-`h_0` `sin_cos_turns` Guard!):**
   - Both `a_eff(h_0)` and `m(h_1)` MUST read **post-Phase-4** `working.held.recurrent_state()` (not stale tick-`n` state!).
   - **Metabolic Caste Rotation (`a_eff(h_0)`):**
     - **CRITICAL Negative-`h_0` Fix (`numerics.rs:541`):** `sin_cos_turns(u)` returns `None` for `u < 0.0`! For `h_0 ∈ [-1.0, 1.0]`, compute `let phase = flife_core::numerics::normalize_turns(0.25 * f64::from(h_0))?; let (sin_a, cos_a) = flife_core::numerics::sin_cos_turns(phase)?;` (mapping `h_0 = -1.0` → `phase = 0.75` → `(sin = -1, cos = 0)` cleanly!), blend `cos_a * a + sin_a * J a` using `V2-01`'s `symplectic_rotate_channels` (`32` single-carrier or `24` Carrier-0 under `V2-15`) and `shrink_to_left_fold_norm_limit` (Trap D!).
     - Wire into `V2-11`'s `effective_affinity`, `world/settle.rs` (`ChemistryOrganism` — **0 changes in `chemistry.metal`!**), `LocalChemistry` (`crates/flife-engine/src/inspect.rs`), and `ColorMapping::Affinity`!
   - **EMT Adhesion Switch (`m(h_1)`):** Multiply organism `i`'s `emt_eff` (`V2-08` `Sweep1Context`) by `(1.0 + f64::from(h_1)).clamp(0.0, 1.0)` (`1.0` at `h_1 = 0`, `0.0` at `h_1 = -1`!).
5. **Juxtacrine Notch-Delta (`C022`, `contact.rs` `Sweep1` + Checkpoint v3 — Clonal Kin & Trap F Fixes!):**
   - **CRITICAL Clonal Kin Rule:** Neighbor averaging `h̄_i = (Σ_j kin_w_ij · h_j[0]) / max(1e-6, Σ_j kin_w_ij)` inside `contact.rs` `Sweep1` MUST weight kin using **genetic `traits.affinity()`** (or `cadherin-4d` when `V2-13` active), **NEVER `a_eff(h_0)`** — otherwise clonal sisters that differentiate (`a` vs `J a`) lose Notch-Delta contact with each other!
   - Persist `last_neighbor_h0: f32` on `Organism` (init `0.0` on founders, newborns, and `intervention::introduce`), serialize in checkpoint v3 (**curing Trap F!**), expose in `flife inspect`, update `Population::column_bytes`/`digest` & `World::footprint()` (`memory_admission`).
   - Mode `"sensor-neighbor-mean-v1"`: feeds `last_neighbor_h0` into `SensorLayout::notch_delta_slot()`.
   - Mode `"direct-lateral-inhibition-v1"`: in Phase 4 right after `update_recurrent_state` produces `h'_0`, apply `h''_0 = (h'_0 - (η_ND as f32) * organism.committed.last_neighbor_h0).clamp(-1.0_f32, 1.0_f32)` — tick-0 spatial symmetry breaking with `0` extra sensor slots!

## Success Criteria
- `--disable epigenetic-recurrence,notch-delta` falls back cleanly to stateless baseline with zero overhead.
- Reference, `flife-backend-cpu` (FrankenTorch CPU), and Metal F16/F32 run recurrent topologies (`S = 2` `108/44` & `S = 4` `108/44`) with **0 alignment deferrals** and **bit-exact** action outputs + `h'`!
- `a_eff(h_0)` works cleanly over all `h_0 ∈ [-1.0, 1.0]` (including negative `h_0 = -1.0, -0.5`!), matches `a` at `h_0 = 0`, `J a` at `h_0 = +1`, `-J a` at `h_0 = -1`, and satisfies left-fold `‖a_eff‖₂² <= affinity_norm_limit²`.
- Checkpoint v3 round-trip preserves `h`, `last_neighbor_h0`, AND newborn `HeldOutput::newborn_with_state` (`evaluated_at == None`) bit-for-bit (`INV-14`, `C.13`).

## Test Plan & E2E Verification
- **Known-answer unit tests (`flife-neural`, `flife-engine`):**
  - `recurrent_epigenetic_gate_bias_and_asymmetric_birth`: verify `b_epi = 2.5` gives `g ≈ 0.076` at `z_g = 0`; verify `asymmetric-stem-v1` equation on `k=0` and `k=1..S`, and newborn `evaluated_at == None` (`C.13`).
  - `a_eff_orthogonal_rotation_full_signed_range_left_fold_safe`: sweep 101 `h_0 ∈ [-1.0, 1.0]` (explicitly testing negative values `-1.0, -0.5, -1e-12`!) over adversarial unit vectors; assert `a_eff(0) == a`, `a_eff(1) == J a`, `a_eff(-1) == -J a`, left-fold `‖a_eff‖₂² <= 1.0`.
  - `notch_delta_clonal_kin_not_broken_by_differentiation_and_checkpoints`: clonal sisters with `h_0 = +1` (`J a`) & `h_0 = 0` (`a`) retain `kin_w == 1.0`; uniform chain bifurcates cleanly without 2-tick oscillation; checkpoint v3 round-trip (including a newborn with `evaluated_at == None` and non-zero `h_child`!) matches `WorldDigest` bit-for-bit!
- **Full-Stack Controller Parity tests (`flife-backend-cpu`, `flife-backend-metal`):**
  - `recurrent_reference_torch_and_metal_f16_f32_bit_exact`: 1,024 organisms across all 5 topologies with `S = 2` (`108/44`) and `S = 4` (`108/44`); assert 0 alignment deferrals and bit-exact outputs + `h'` across all 3 controller routes!
- **E2E test (`flife-engine`):**
  - `e2e_clonal_core_sheath_differentiation_with_waste`: 1,024 ticks (`64²`) pairing `V2-11` (`J a_eff`) + `V2-07` (`c_den`) + `V2-12` (`S = 2`, `108/44`) vs `--disable epigenetic-recurrence,notch-delta` & `chemistry-only`; log within-lineage `h_0` variance, `corr(h_0, c_den)`, Metal device ns, `INV-03` residual, `C.7`/`C.8`, and `memory_admission`.

# V2-14: 4-Neighbor Flux-Reinforced Murray / *Physarum* Self-Carving Vascular Field (`#15` `C007`, Feature Slug: `vascular-field`)

## Background & Justification
In isotropic diffusion, 1-D transport corridors have maximum curvature and dissipate fastest — making living vascular trees and long-range nutrient conduits impossible. Making finite-volume edge conductance respond **superlinearly** (`μ = 1.5`) to actual energy flux triggers the exact Banavar / Tero (*Physarum polycephalum*) / Murray's-Law branching instability: uniform sheet diffusion spontaneously collapses into **hierarchical, anastomosing capillary trees** connecting energy sources directly into hungry colonies, carrying chemical signals 20–40× farther along living vessels while unused branches prune away — **100% inside pure field-mediated physics (`INV-08`) with `0%` MLP cost!**

**Crucial `AUDIT-1` Denominator Optimization:** Switching from 8-neighbor (`16 B/cell`, `2.4–3.7×` Metal `softfloat64` blowup) to **4-neighbor orthogonal edges** (`2` unique edges/cell: east & north = **`8 B/cell` per buffer = `820 KB` at `320²`**) lets us **directly reuse `V2-09`'s precomputed `(edge_x, edge_y)` 5-point `field_stencil_flux` kernel** — cutting memory in half AND dropping Metal Phase 2 overhead to `~1–2%`!

## Technical Approach
1. **Modular Configuration (`V2Feature::VascularField`, slug `vascular-field`):**
   - Under `v2.vascular` (default `enabled = true` on pure-field `supercolony`/`auto` without `[contact]`, toggleable on/off via TOML or `--disable vascular-field` / `--enable vascular-field` → `0 B` edge allocation and bit-exact fallback when disabled!):
     - `enabled: bool`
     - `minimum_conductance_ratio: f64` (`g_min ∈ (0.01, 1.0]`, default `0.025` for `40:1` vascular contrast!)
     - `maximum_diffusion: f64` (`D_max > 0`, e.g., `10 D_0 = 0.30` — STILL `substeps = 1` on `confluent-world`'s 16.7× CFL headroom!)
     - `reinforcement_rate_per_second: f64` (`α_v > 0`)
     - `pruning_rate_per_second: f64` (`γ_v > 0`)
     - `flux_half_saturation: f64` (`J_0 > 0`)
     - `flux_exponent: f64` (`μ > 0`, default `1.5`, allows `0.7` sublinear control runs for Brenner falsifier!).
2. **Ping-Pong `FieldPair` Storage (`C.8` Cancel-Safety!) & Persistence (`flife-field/src/state.rs`, `checkpoint.rs`, `crop.rs`):**
   - Store `edge_x_cond: Vec<f32>` and `edge_y_cond: Vec<f32>` (`∈ [g_min, 1.0]`, init `0.25`) on **BOTH buffers of `FieldPair`** (`16 B/cell` total pair, **`0 B` when disabled**!) so Phase 2 writes `next_edge_cond` into the spare buffer and dropping a `Candidate` leaves committed vascular state **bit-for-bit untouched (`C.8`)**!
   - Persist committed `edge_x_cond, edge_y_cond` in checkpoint v3 (`Field` chunk), hash into `World::digest` (`world.rs:1924`), admit in `World::footprint()` (`memory_admission`, `INV-15`), carry vascular edge slices cleanly in `crop.rs`/`graft.rs`, and expose optional `vascular_conductance` in `flife inspect --field`.
3. **Pre-Transport Composition & Substep-Invariant Superlinear Murray Update (`flife-field/src/transport.rs`, `step.rs`):**
   - **Pre-Transport Face Conductances:** Compute F64 `edge_x[c] = (r_max_x * f64::from(g^E_c) * phi_tj_x).min(r_max_x)` (multiplicatively composed with `V2-09`'s tight-junction harmonic permeability if both are enabled!) and execute `V2-09`'s exact doubly-stochastic 5-point `field_stencil_flux`!
   - **Substep-Invariant Energy-Plane Flux Magnitude:** From pre-transport committed Carrier-0 energy `e_0`, compute:
     $$|F_e| = (\text{edge\_x}_0[c] \cdot \text{substeps as f64}) \cdot \big|\text{f64::from}(e_0[c]) - \text{f64::from}(e_0[\text{east}])\big|$$
     so changing `D_max` across a substep boundary never distorts `J_0` scaling!
   - **Overflow Guard & Exact Arbitrary-`μ` Arithmetic:**
     - `ratio = |F_e| / J_0`; if `ratio > 1.0e100`, `sat = 1.0`; else if `ratio == 0.0`, `sat = 0.0`; else:
       - Fast path when `μ == 1.5`: `r_mu = ratio * ratio.sqrt()`;
       - General `μ > 0` (including the preregistered `μ = 0.7` Brenner falsifier control!): `r_mu = flife_core::numerics::pow_positive(ratio, μ)?`;
       - `sat = r_mu / (1.0 + r_mu)`.
     - Round once to F32:
       $$g'_e = \operatorname{clamp}_{[g_{\min}, 1.0]}\!\Big(g_e + \Delta t \big[\alpha_v\,\text{sat}\,(1.0 - g_e) - \gamma_v\,(g_e - g_{\min})\big]\Big)$$
     - Modifying `g_e` creates/destroys **0 energy** (`INV-03` exact!).
4. **Metal Bit-Exact Parity (`crates/flife-backend-metal/src/{numerics.metal, motion.metal, field.rs, field.metal}`):**
   - Reuse `V2-09`'s `field_stencil_flux` directly!
   - Hoist existing `d_pow_positive` from `motion.metal:109–126` into `numerics.metal` so BOTH `motion.metal` and `field.metal` share one exact `softfloat64` `d_pow_positive`!
   - Add one compact 2-edge/cell `vascular_update` kernel in `field.metal` (16× fewer threads than the 33-plane stencil!) matching CPU bit-for-bit on BOTH `μ = 1.5` and arbitrary `μ = 0.7`!

## Success Criteria
- `--disable vascular-field` allocates `0 B` edge state and matches baseline/tight-junction transport **bit-for-bit**.
- Exact `INV-01`, `INV-02`, `INV-03` (`residual < 1e-5`), `INV-08` (pure field!), `INV-11` determinism, `C.7`/`C.8`, and `memory_admission`.
- Overflow guard handles `|F_e| = 1e35` and `|F_e| = 0.0` with zero NaN/Inf.
- On a synthetic 2-point source-to-sink test, `μ = 1.5` carves a sharp bimodal channel (`g_e → 1.0`) while `μ = 0.7` remains smooth/unbranched.
- CPU and Metal `field.metal` match bit-for-bit on BOTH `μ = 1.5` and `μ = 0.7`; checkpoint v3 round-trip matches `WorldDigest` bit-for-bit.

## Test Plan & E2E Verification
- **Known-answer & physics unit tests (`flife-field::transport`):**
  - `vascular_exact_conservation_and_cone`: heterogeneous `g_e ∈ [0.025, 1.0]`, verify pre-decay `|ΔE|/E < 1e-5` and exact `INV-02` cone over 100 steps.
  - `vascular_murray_branching_vs_sublinear_control`: `32×32` 1 source / 2 sinks, 500 ticks at `μ = 1.5` vs `μ = 0.7`; assert bimodal `g_e` (`2–25%` high-conductance edges) at `μ = 1.5` vs unimodal at `μ = 0.7`!
  - `vascular_extreme_flux_overflow_guard_and_substep_invariance`: `|F_e| = 1e35`, `J_0 = 1e-12` → `sat == 1.0`, finite `g'_e`; verify substep-invariant `|F_e|` across `substeps = 1` vs `2`.
  - `vascular_disabled_zero_alloc_and_bit_exact`: verify `--disable vascular-field` allocates `0 B` and matches baseline bit-for-bit.
- **Metal parity, `C.7`/`C.8` & Checkpoint tests:**
  - `metal_vascular_field_bit_exact_with_cpu_mu_1_5_and_0_7`: 32 ticks (`64²`) on Metal vs CPU for BOTH `μ = 1.5` and `μ = 0.7`; assert bit-exact equality on all planes AND both `edge_x_cond, edge_y_cond`.
  - `checkpoint_v3_crop_and_c8_cancel_preserve_vascular_conductance`: verify `C.8` cancel leaves committed `edge_*_cond` untouched, `crop`/`graft` preserves slices, and checkpoint restore matches `WorldDigest` bit-for-bit.
- **E2E test (`flife-engine`):**
  - `e2e_vascular_oases_carve_living_highways`: 1,024 ticks (`64²`) pairing `V2-02` (`oases`) + `V2-14` (`μ = 1.5` vs `μ = 0.7` & `--disable vascular-field`), logging conductance bimodality, flow-path correlation length, and `INV-03` residual.

     - `trail_emission_share: f64` (`p_1 ∈ (0.0, 0.5]`, default `0.20`)
     - `trail_energy_density_scale: f64` (`R_scale_1 > 0`).
2. **Runtime 33/34-Plane Field Generalization — Complete Verified CPU Callsite List:**
   - Support `34` F32 planes when enabled (preserving exact `33`-plane layout when disabled!):
     - **Carrier 0 (25 planes):** Plane `0` = `e_0`; Planes `1..=24` = `m^{(0)}_{0..23}` (fast `D_0, λ_0`; external Gaussian sources, uptake, chemistry, `byproducts`, and `recycling` operate strictly here!).
     - **Carrier 1 (9 planes):** Plane `25` = `e_1`; Planes `26..=33` = `m^{(1)}_{0..7}` (ultra-slow `D_1, λ_1`, 1 substep; non-destructive trails!).
   - Parameterize EVERY hardcoded `FIELD_PLANES` / `CHANNELS + 1` assertion across the workspace cleanly:
     - `crates/flife-field/src/{grid.rs, state.rs, layout.rs, footprint.rs, invariants.rs, pyramid.rs, transport.rs, step.rs}`
     - **`crates/flife-field/src/uptake.rs:354,361`:** Check `field.planes()` and debit ONLY Carrier 0 (`e_0` & `24` moment planes `1..=24`), leaving `e_1` (plane 25) and `m^{(1)}` (planes 26..33) **bit-for-bit untouched**!
     - **`crates/flife-field/src/deposit.rs:964,1025`:** Check `field.planes()` and accept `CarrierSpec { energy_plane, first_moment_plane, moment_count }` (`(0, 1, 24)` for Carrier 0; `(25, 26, 8)` for Carrier 1; `(0, 1, 32)` single-carrier!).
     - **`crates/flife-engine/src/world.rs:3611` (`compositions_into`) & `inspect.rs` (`LocalChemistry`):** Check `all_data.len() == observed.planes() * total_cells` and iterate `.take(active_carrier0_channels)` (`24` when dual-carrier, zeroing `24..32` in `batch[b]` so `c = 24` NEVER reads `e_1 / e_0 > 1000`!).
     - **`crates/flife-engine/src/intervention.rs:744`, `world/checkpoint.rs:236,539`, `world/crop.rs`, `crates/flife-render/src/epoch.rs:424`:** Loop over `field.planes()` (`33 | 34`) cleanly!
3. **Phase 2 Dual-Carrier Transport, Decay & Composition with `V2-09` & `V2-14`:**
   - Run independent `TransportPlan` + scalar decay on Carrier 0 (`planes 0..25`) and Carrier 1 (`planes 25..34`):
     - Carrier 0 uses `edge_0 = (r_0 * g_vascular * phi_tj).min(r_0)` (both tight junctions AND vascular arteries!).
     - Carrier 1 uses `edge_1 = (r_1 * phi_tj).min(r_1)` — impeded by `V2-09` tight junctions, **NOT** accelerated by `V2-14` vascular arteries (so ant trails don't smear down vessels!).
   - Book BOTH energy planes' decay strictly to existing **`Flow::Decay`** (`flife-core/src/ledger.rs:60`)!
   - **Dual-Cone Check (`invariants.rs` + `check.metal`):** Independently verify `‖m^{(0)}_c‖₂ <= e_{0,c}` AND `‖m^{(1)}_c‖₂ <= e_{1,c}` within `ConeTolerance`. Update `FieldState::energy_total()` to sum `e_0 + e_1` so `INV-03` closes identically!
4. **Phase 3 Pyramid, 108-Input Sensors & 33-Term Motion Response (`pyramid.rs`, `sensors.rs`):**
   - `SensorPyramid` averages all `34` planes (`+3.0%`).
   - `sensors.rs` computes `q_0 = R_0/(R_0 + R_scale_0)`, `Z_{0..23} = M^{(0)}_{0..23}/(R_0 + R_floor)`, `Z_{24..31} = M^{(1)}_{0..7}/(R_1 + R_floor)` (decoupled from bright food `R_0` so crisp trails NEVER wash out!), plus the 4 Carrier-1 signals into `SensorLayout::dual_carrier_slots()`: `(q_1, tanh(L ∂_x q_1), tanh(L ∂_y q_1), ‖Z^{(1)}‖_2.min(1.0))`!
   - Keep `Traits::motion_response` at its exact **33** terms (`χ_e ∇q_0 + Σ_{0..23} χ_k ∇Z^{(0)} + Σ_{24..31} χ_k ∇Z^{(1)}`), exposing Carrier-1 energy gradient `∇q_1` cleanly to the neural controller (`SensorLayout`) — zero `Traits` size bloat!
5. **Phase 7/9 Emission Split & Trap-C Safe Double-Deposit (`emission.rs`, `world.rs`, `world/settle.rs`):**
   - Allocate dedicated **`Scratch::trail_emissions: Deposits`** + **`DecisionLane::trail_emissions: Deposits`** ONLY when `dual-carrier-trails` is enabled (**`0 B` when disabled**, admitted in `World::footprint()` / `memory_admission` per `INV-15`!).
   - From organism's paid emission `paid` (settled via `EnergyBudget::pay` / `emission.metal`), transfer efficiency `eff`, and unit 32-D direction `d = (d^{(0)}[0..24], d^{(1)}[0..8])`:
     - `paid_1 = (p_1 * paid).min(paid)`
     - `paid_0 = sub_down(paid, paid_1)`
     - `q_0 = (eff * paid_0).min(paid_0)` (strictly `<= paid_0` ⇒ passes `Deposits::push` check!)
     - `q_1 = (eff * paid_1).min(paid_1)` (strictly `<= paid_1` ⇒ passes `Deposits::push` check!)
     - Stage `(paid_0, q_0, dir = [d^{(0)}[0..24], 0..0])` into `lane.emissions` and `(paid_1, q_1, dir = [d^{(1)}[0..8], 0..0])` into `lane.trail_emissions` — **no renormalization needed** because `‖d^{(0)}‖₂ <= 1` and `‖d^{(1)}‖₂ <= 1` automatically (zero `0/0` NaN, Trap-D safe!).
   - In Phase 9, reduce `emissions` onto Carrier 0 `(0, 1, 24)` and `trail_emissions` onto Carrier 1 `(25, 26, 8)`, and book **ONE combined `Transfer::Emission(debited = Σ paid, credited = applied_0 + applied_1)`** (`applied_0 + applied_1 <= paid_0 + paid_1 <= paid` strictly guaranteed; loss → `Flow::EmissionLoss`)!
6. **ALL 6 Affected Metal Kernels (`crates/flife-backend-metal/src/`):**
   1. **`chemistry.metal:32,114`:** Parameterize `active_channels = 24 | 32` so Carrier-0 chemistry never reads plane 25 (`e_1`) or planes 26..33!
   2. **`reduce.metal:73,79` (`grants_debit` & `deposits_reduce`):** Parameterize `grants_debit` with `carrier0_moments = 24 | 32` so uptake NEVER modifies `e_1` or `m^{(1)}`; parameterize `deposits_reduce` with `(energy_plane, first_moment, moment_count)`!
   3. **`field.metal:161` (`source_moments` & `field_stencil_flux`):** Parameterize `CHANNELS = 24 | 32` so external sources never write into `e_1`; run `field_stencil_flux` on `0..25` (with `edge_0`) and `25..34` (with `edge_1`)!
   4. **`sensors.metal:14` + `sensors.rs`:** Parameterize `PLANES = 33 | 34`!
   5. **`check.metal` + `check.rs`:** Check BOTH Lorentz cones independently (`(0, 1..25)` and `(25, 26..34)`)!
   6. **`controller.metal`:** Already generalized by `V2-01` for `108`/`112` inputs (`% 4 == 0`, 100% `half4` coalesced!).
   - Persist 34 planes in checkpoint v3 (`Field` chunk) and expose `trail_energy` in `flife inspect --field`.

## Success Criteria
- `--disable dual-carrier-trails` reverts cleanly to 33-plane single-carrier mode **bit-for-bit** with `0 B` trail scratch.
- Both Lorentz cones hold within `ConeTolerance` every tick; `INV-03` closes within `< 1e-5` via `Flow::Decay` and combined `Transfer::Emission`.
- Carrier-1 trails (`e_1`, `m^{(1)}`) remain **bit-for-bit untouched** when 50 organisms feed from Carrier 0 on the same cell (on both CPU and Metal `grants_debit`!).
- 108-input F16 Metal controller achieves **0 alignment deferrals** and full `half4` Layer-0 coalescing; all 6 dual-carrier Metal kernels match CPU bit-for-bit; `C.7`/`C.8`, `crop`/`graft`, `memory_admission`, and checkpoint v3 round-trip match `WorldDigest`.

## Test Plan & E2E Verification
- **Known-answer & invariant unit tests (`flife-field`, `flife-neural`, `flife-engine`):**
  - `dual_carrier_independent_cones_and_exact_ledger`: deposit sharp spikes at `D_0/D_1 = 100, λ_0/λ_1 = 20`; step 128 ticks; verify both cones hold, Carrier 1 stays `≥ 5×` sharper, `Flow::Decay` & `INV-03 < 1e-5`.
  - `dual_carrier_grants_debit_leaves_carrier1_bit_identical`: 50 feeding organisms on `(e_0 = 5, e_1 = 2, m^(1) != 0)`; assert `e_0` depletes while `e_1` AND `m^(1)` are **bit-for-bit unchanged** on both CPU & Metal `reduce.metal`!
  - `dual_carrier_sub_unit_split_zero_nan_and_transfer_bounds`: test `d^(1) = 0`, `d^(0) = 0`, and `p_1 = 0.5`; assert zero NaN, `q_k <= paid_k`, and `applied_0 + applied_1 <= paid`.
  - `dual_carrier_disabled_matches_33_plane_bit_exact`: assert `--disable dual-carrier-trails` matches 33-plane baseline bit-for-bit with `0 B` trail scratch.
- **Metal parity, `C.7`/`C.8` & Checkpoint tests:**
  - `metal_dual_carrier_34_planes_all_6_kernels_bit_exact_with_cpu`: 32 ticks (`64²`) on Metal vs CPU (with `V2-09` & `V2-14` active too!); assert bit-exact F32 equality on all 34 planes and organism states.
  - `checkpoint_v3_crop_c7_c8_dual_carrier_roundtrip`: verify checkpoint restore, `crop`/`graft`, Compact vs FreeList (`C.7`), Candidate cancel (`C.8`), `memory_admission`, and `flife inspect --field`.
- **E2E test (`flife-engine`):**
  - `e2e_dual_carrier_forms_persistent_pheromone_ridges`: 1,024 ticks (`64²`) on `V2-02` Oases comparing `D_1 = 0.01 D_0, λ_1 = 0.05 λ_0` vs matched `D_1 = D_0, λ_1 = λ_0` & `--disable dual-carrier-trails`; log Carrier-1 kurtosis, ridge lifetime, and trail-aligned flux.

# V2-16: Pure Read-Only (`INV-09`) Render `Epoch` & FrankenManim Visual Mappings for Cell State, Polarity, Vessels & Trails (Feature Slug: `v2-visual-mappings`)

## Background & Justification
Currently (`crates/flife-render/src/epoch.rs`, `crates/flife-manim/src/mapping.rs`, `cloud.rs`), every organism renders as an identical circular dot colored only by static lineage/affinity/energy/motion, and the field texture shows only single-carrier energy. Once Bundle A and Bundle B evolve **clonal 2-cell-type differentiation (`h_0`)**, **apical-basal epithelial polarity (`p_i`)**, **self-carving Murray capillary arteries (`g_e`)**, and **persistent Carrier-1 ant pheromone highways (`e_1`)**, human observers need **honest, pure read-only (`INV-09`)** visual mappings alongside raw diagnostic views to inspect these structures in Studio and Cinema exports!

Also directly satisfies open bead **`FL-052` (`flife-bml`)**'s requirement for *"one new visual mapping without core rewrites"*.

## Technical Approach
1. **Strict `Scope::Presentation` Contract (`INV-09`):**
   - Classify `V2Feature::V2VisualMappings` (`v2-visual-mappings`) explicitly as `Scope::Presentation`: enabling or disabling it NEVER alters scientific `ModelDescriptor`, `config_hash` scientific identity (outside `[presentation]`), or `WorldDigest`!
   - When disabled (`--disable v2-visual-mappings` or `v1`), `Epoch` buffers and projections remain 100% identical to `v1`!
2. **Immutable Compact `Epoch` Extensions (`crates/flife-render/src/epoch.rs`):**
   - Strictly read-only, identity-ordered (never storage-slot order, `C.7`), fixed-capacity pre-allocated at world creation (zero per-publish allocation, honestly admitted under `flife-render`'s `Layout` memory bounds per `INV-15`!):
     - Optional `cell_states: Vec<i8>` (`1 B/org`, quantized `h_0 ∈ [-1, 1]` → `-127..=127` when `V2-12` active).
     - Optional `polarities: Vec<i16>` (`2 B/org`, quantized `atan2(p_y, p_x)` when `V2-08` active).
     - Primary `FieldTexture` energy plane reads **Carrier 0 (`e_0`)** when `V2-15` is active; optional secondary field overlays carry `trail_energy: Vec<f32>` (Carrier 1 `e_1`, `V2-15`) and `vascular_conductance: Vec<f32>` (mean incident `g_e`, `V2-14`).
3. **New Pure Visual Mappings & Studio Wiring (`crates/flife-manim/src/{mapping.rs, cloud.rs}`, `crates/flife-core/src/schema.rs`, `crates/flife-studio/`):**
   - `ColorMapping::CellState` (`"cell-state-v1"`): keeps founder `LineageId` base hue and modulates lightness/chroma/secondary tint cleanly by `cell_states[i]` (`h_0`), making clonal **core-vs-sheath / queen-vs-worker / tip-vs-stalk** differentiation immediately legible!
   - `ColorMapping::Polarity` (`"polarity-v1"`): cyclic perceptual wheel mapping `polarities[i]` angle, making curved 1-cell hollow cysts and epithelial sheet alignment pop visually (paired with optional short apical orientation tick in sphere mode!).
   - `FieldMapping` modes (`"energy"`, `"trail-carrier"`, `"vascular-conductance"`): clean linear/log perceptual ramp rendering persistent ant highways (`e_1`) and glowing capillary arteries (`g_e`) underneath the organisms!
   - **Studio Keybindings & HUD Cap:** Wire `flife-studio` keys (`8` → `CellState`, `9` → `Polarity`, `C` cycling field overlays `energy → trail-carrier → vascular-conductance`) and legend swatches strictly within FL-024's **`33,792` HUD vertex cap**!
   - **Honesty Guardrail (`AGENTS.md`):** Never paint fake membranes, never feed visual overlays back into physics, and ALWAYS keep raw unstyled views (`raw`, `lineage`, `affinity`) available alongside aesthetic views (Gate G5)!

## Success Criteria
- Zero scientific state coupling (`INV-09`): running headless vs publishing every tick with `cell-state-v1`, `polarity-v1`, `trail-carrier`, or `vascular-conductance` yields **bit-identical `WorldDigest`**.
- Exact `C.7` slot-arrangement invariance: `Arrangement::Compact` vs `Arrangement::FreeList` project bit-identical `Epoch` payloads.
- `crates/flife-studio/tests/overlay.rs` and `crates/flife-studio/tests/admission.rs` pass within FL-024's HUD vertex cap and memory admission bounds.
- `flife render` produces crisp PNG frames for Bundle A and Bundle B with non-degenerate pixel variance.

## Test Plan & E2E Verification
- **Unit & Property tests (`flife-render`, `flife-manim`, `flife-studio`):**
  - `epoch_v2_projections_slot_order_invariant_c7`: assert bit-identical `Epoch` between `Compact` and `FreeList` populations carrying `h_0`, `p_i`, `g_e`, `e_1`.
  - `cell_state_and_polarity_color_mapping_finite_and_distinct`: verify valid RGB `[0, 1]` across full input ranges and strong visual separation between `h_0 = -1` and `h_0 = +1` within one `LineageId`.
  - `inv09_presentation_zero_scientific_feedback`: step identical worlds headless vs all new mappings & `--disable v2-visual-mappings`; assert bit-identical `WorldDigest`.
  - Existing `crates/flife-studio/tests/overlay.rs` and `admission.rs` extended for keys `8`/`9`/`C` and new `Epoch` buffers.
- **E2E render test (`flife-cli`):**
  - `e2e_cli_render_v2_visual_mappings`: run 64 ticks of mini Bundle A & Bundle B worlds, invoke `flife render` with `cell-state-v1`, `polarity-v1`, `trail-carrier`, and `vascular-conductance`; assert valid non-degenerate PNG outputs and zero warnings.
acceptance_criteria: v2-visual-mappings (V2Feature::V2VisualMappings, Scope::Presentation) never alters ModelDescriptor scientific identity or WorldDigest (INV-09); pre-allocates identity-ordered read-only Epoch views (cell_states: Vec<i8>, polarities: Vec<i16>, trail_energy: Vec<f32>, vascular_conductance: Vec<f32>; primary FieldTexture reads Carrier-0 e_0 under V2-15); adds ColorMapping::CellState ('cell-state-v1'), ColorMapping::Polarity ('polarity-v1'), and FieldMapping overlays ('trail-carrier', 'vascular-conductance'); wires Studio keys (8, 9, C) within FL-024's 33,792 HUD vertex cap; --disable v2-visual-mappings matches v1 Epoch; C.7 slot-invariance, INV-09 bit-exactness, studio overlay/admission tests & flife render E2E pass.

Evidence: test:flife-render::src/lib.rs::all(2/2 PASS), test:flife-render::tests/epochs.rs::all(17/17 PASS), test:flife-render::tests/leases.rs::all(7/7 PASS), test:flife-manim::tests/field.rs::all(13/13 PASS), test:flife-manim::tests/v2_visual_mappings.rs::all(7/7 PASS), test:flife-studio::tests/controls.rs::all(25/25 PASS), test:flife-studio::tests/overlay.rs::all(11/11 PASS), test:flife-studio::tests/cinema_export.rs::all(6/6 PASS).

# V2-17: Stage-2 Verification (`⤴-3`), Bundle A & B Showcase Presets, All-21 & Leave-One-Out E2E Suites & Four-Claims Report

## Background & Justification
This final integration and qualification bead unites **BOTH Bundle A (Living Multi-Layered Animal Tissues)** and **Bundle B (Vascularized Eusocial Super-Colonies & Neural Foraging Networks)** into default-enabled, modularly toggleable showcase presets, exhaustive automated end-to-end verification tests with rich structured JSON logging, and honest visual + quantitative proof against every control (`--v1-compat`, `--disable <feature>`, `-chemistry-only`, `-fixed-controller`, `-fresh-offspring`, and `confluent-world` v1 baseline).

## Technical Approach
1. **Execute Preregistered Quickie `⤴-3` (`128²` & `320²`, ≥ 4 discovery + 2 held-out seeds, reusing `V2-10`'s `v2_diagnostics`):**
   - **Arm A — Super-Colony Waves, Arteries & Trails (`inv08_pure_field = true`!):**
     Run `V2-02` (`oases`) + `V2-03` (`senescence`) + `V2-05` (`so2-motor`) + `V2-04` (`surplus-emission`, `excitable-relay`, `wake-offset`) + `V2-09` (`tight-junctions`) + `V2-11` (`lysis-recycling`) + `V2-14` (`vascular-field`, `μ = 1.5` vs `μ = 0.7` & `--disable vascular-field`) + `V2-15` (`dual-carrier-trails` vs `D_1 = D_0` & `--disable dual-carrier-trails`).
     - *Verify:* Bimodal vascular arteries & Carrier-1 pheromone ridges visibly organize **organism dots** (not just hidden field planes!) across `≥ 3×` baseline correlation length; propagating excitable waves exceed white-noise floor `≥ 3×`; `evolving` beats `fixed-controller` & `chemistry-only`.
   - **Arm B — Clonal 2-Cell-Type Stratified Tissues (`inv08_pure_field = false`):**
     Run `V2-08` (`pcp-polarity`) + `V2-07` (`hippo-crowding` `c_max = 4.5, expose_sensor = true`) + `V2-09` (`tight-junctions`) + `V2-11` (`symplectic-waste`, `lysis-recycling`) + `V2-12` (`epigenetic-recurrence` `S = 2` + `notch-delta` `sensor-neighbor-mean-v1` → **`108` sensors / `44` raw outputs**, `% 4 == 0`!) + `V2-13` (`trophallaxis`, `cadherin-4d`) + `V2-03` (`senescence`) + `V2-05` (`so2-motor`).
     - *Verify:* Within single clonal `LineageId`s, bimodal spatial stratification of `h_0` (`core` eating `a` vs `sheath` eating `J a`!), crisp 1-cell hollow cysts (`stacking < 1.25`, `|ψ_6| < 0.55`), `> 3×` `H4` boundary-vs-interior leak ratio, and `≥ 1.5×` interior survival depth via trophallaxis!

title: V2-02: Phase-staggered ephemeral oasis resource landscapes (C028, modular `oases` toggle, sources.rs + field.metal)
description:
# V2-02: Phase-Staggered Ephemeral Oasis Resource Landscapes (`#5` `C028`, Feature Slug: `oases`)

## Background & Justification
Our adversarial evolution audit (`AUDIT-2`) identified the **All-You-Can-Eat Buffet Trap**: `confluent-world.toml` spreads 25 huge overlapping `σ = 15.0` Gaussian sources across an `80 × 80` torus with 3× surplus power. In a spatially uniform saturated buffet, sitting still and emitting passively is nearly optimal — suppressing Darwinian selection for closed-loop neural navigation (`V2-05`), pheromone highways (`V2-15`), self-carving vasculature (`V2-14`), and trophallactic bridges (`V2-13`).

Replacing uniform static sources with **compact, phase-staggered ephemeral oases separated by barren corridors** costs **`0.00%` runtime compute**, **`0 B` extra persistent RAM**, and **multiplies the emergent evolutionary payoff of every other v2 mechanism by 3–5×**.

## Technical Approach
1. **Modular Configuration (`V2Feature::Oases`, slug `oases`):**
   - Under `v2.oases` (default `enabled = true` on pure-field `supercolony`/`auto` without `[contact]`, toggleable on/off via TOML or `--disable oases` / `--enable oases` → exact constant-power baseline when disabled!):
     - `enabled: bool`
     - `bloom_period_seconds: f64` (`> 0.0`, default `24.0 s` = `768` ticks)
     - `minimum_power_fraction: f64` (`∈ [0.0, 1.0]`, default `0.0` for crisp ephemeral desert blooms or `0.05` floor)
     - `sigma_min_world_units: f64`, `sigma_max_world_units: f64` (`0 < σ_min <= σ_max`, e.g., `2.0–3.5` world units, deterministically drawn per `SourceId` via `Stream::Sources` `SemanticRng`).
   - **Mandatory `0/0 = NaN` Validation Guard (`validate.rs`):** Enforce **`sources.count >= 3 || v2.oases.minimum_power_fraction > 0.0`**! With `M = 2` and `min_frac = 0.0`, at `t/T = 0.0, 0.5, 1.0` both `u_0 = 0` and `u_1 = 0.5` give `sin(2π u_j) = 0 ⇒ Σ w_j = 0 ⇒ 0/0 = NaN`. With `M >= 3`, phase spacing `1/M <= 1/3 < 1/2` guarantees strictly positive `Σ w_j(t) > 0` for all `t`! Also include a defensive `sum_w > 0.0` guard returning zero deposit if ever violated.
2. **Deterministic Power Modulation (`crates/flife-field/src/sources.rs`, `crates/flife-engine/src/world.rs`):**
   - For source `j ∈ 0..M` at mid-tick time `t = (n + 0.5) Δt`, compute phase `u_j = (t / T_bloom) + (j as f64 / M as f64)`, normalize into `[0.0, 1.0)` via `flife_core::numerics::normalize_turns(u_j)?`, and evaluate `let (sin_val, _) = flife_core::numerics::sin_cos_turns(phase)?;` (NEVER host libm `f64::sin`!).
   - Raw envelope: `w_j(t) = min_frac + (1.0 - min_frac) * sin_val.max(0.0).powi(2)`.
   - **Global Constant-Power Staggering (`AUDIT-2` Extinction Guard):** Normalize across the `M` sources via exact `P_j(t) = (M as f64 * P_base) * (w_j(t) / sum_w)` so **total injected world power stays constant `M * P_base` across every tick**, preventing synchronous global extinction when individual oases fade!
   - When `P_j(t) == 0.0`, skip depositing source `j` cleanly (`declared = 0.0`, `applied = 0.0`) without empty-support or divide-by-zero errors.
   - Preserve exact **Appendix C.17 `fixed-total-power`** normalization (`q_c = P_j(t) Δt · k_c / Σ k`) on every active source.
3. **Metal Bit-Exact Parity (`crates/flife-backend-metal/src/field.rs`, `field.metal`):**
   - Currently `field.metal:19` uses `DESCRIPTOR = 73` words and reads global `(r², 2σ²)` from `header[10..13]`.
   - Expand `DESCRIPTOR` to **`77` words** (storing per-source `cutoff_radius_sq` and `two_sigma_sq` as `2×2` binary64 words at offsets `73..77`), pass modulated `P_j(t)` into `deposit_energy`, and compute per-source `SourceSupport`, `axes`, and `ranks` in `MetalField` so heterogeneous `σ_j` matches CPU `softfloat64` bit-for-bit!
4. **Checkpointing & Digest (`INV-14`, `C.8`):**
   - `P_j(t)` is a pure deterministic function of committed tick `n` and canonical config; persist and verify per-source `σ_j` in `Environment` chunk v3 (`checkpoint.rs`) and hash into `World::digest`.

## Success Criteria
- Disabling `oases` (`--disable oases` or `enabled = false`) matches constant-source baseline **bit-for-bit**.
- Validation rejects `M = 2, minimum_power_fraction = 0.0` cleanly with a `ConfigIssue`.
- With `oases` enabled (`M ≥ 3`), total global injected power stays constant across full bloom cycles while creating high-contrast oases separated by barren corridors (`e_c → 0`) and zero `INV-03` ledger drift (`residual < 1e-5`).
- CPU and Metal `MetalField` match bit-for-bit across zero-power, peak-power, and heterogeneous `σ_j` transitions.

## Test Plan & E2E Verification
- **Known-answer & negative unit tests (`flife-field`, `flife-core`):**
  - `oasis_envelope_constant_total_power_and_zero_skip`: verify `sin_cos_turns(normalize_turns(...))` over 2 full periods (`M = 3, 4, 6, 8`), exact `P_j(t) == 0` skip, `C.17` per-source power conservation, and zero `INV-02` cone breaches.
  - `oasis_m2_zero_min_frac_rejected_by_validate`: assert `M = 2, min_frac = 0.0` fails `validate()`, while `M = 2, min_frac = 0.05` and `M = 3, min_frac = 0.0` pass!
  - `oasis_disabled_matches_constant_sources_bit_exact`: assert bit-identical `WorldDigest` when `oases.enabled = false` vs baseline.
  - `heterogeneous_sigma_resolution_invariance`: verify `σ_0 = 1.5, σ_1 = 4.0` inject identical total power on `64²` vs `128²`.
- **Metal parity & Invariant tests (`flife-backend-metal`, `flife-engine`):**
  - `metal_field_matches_cpu_on_pulsing_heterogeneous_oases`: 64 ticks spanning zero/peak transitions with heterogeneous `σ_j`; assert bit-exact F32 equality on all planes.
  - `oasis_candidate_cancel_leaves_state_bit_identical` (`C.8`).
- **E2E test (`flife-engine`):**
  - `e2e_oasis_landscape_survives_and_resumes_bit_exact`: 1,024 ticks (`128²`, 4 staggered compact oases), checkpoint at 512, restore to 1,024, emit structured telemetry (field energy Gini/spatial contrast, `INV-03` residual), assert exact `WorldDigest`.
acceptance_criteria: v2.oases (V2Feature::Oases, slug 'oases') modulates per-source power via host-independent flife_core::numerics::sin_cos_turns(normalize_turns(u_j)) with constant-total-power normalization, enforcing sources.count >= 3 || minimum_power_fraction > 0.0 in validate.rs (zero 0/0 NaN); field.metal DESCRIPTOR expanded to 77 words with per-source (r_j^2, 2*sigma_j^2) and SourceSupport; --disable oases matches constant-source baseline bit-for-bit; CPU & Metal match bit-for-bit; C.8 cancel & checkpoint v3 round-trip bit-exact; INV-03 residual < 1e-5.

title: V2-03: Gompertz metabolic senescence ramp (C027, modular `senescence` toggle, costs.rs + motion.metal)
description:
# V2-03: Gompertz Metabolic Senescence Ramp (`#7` `C027`, Feature Slug: `senescence`)

## Background & Justification
In current `colony-world` and `confluent-world` runs, maintenance cost `c_basal` is strictly age-independent (`crates/flife-engine/src/costs.rs`). Once a world hits its population ceiling, early-winning adults live essentially forever while `3.7 million` birth attempts are refused (`experiments/showcase/README.md:290`). This freezes generational turnover, starves natural-death recycling (`V2-11`), and slows untrained evolution by `5–10×` — even though `sensors.rs` ALREADY feeds `age / (age + age_scale)` as `inputs[100]`!

Adding a quadratic Gompertz metabolic senescence ramp costs **`0.00%` runtime**, **`0 B` extra persistent RAM**, and ~45 LOC across CPU & Metal while guaranteeing continuous Darwinian turnover across both Bundle A and Bundle B. *(Dephase discipline: treat honestly as an anti-stagnation generational-turnover engine, not late-life kamikaze caste magic.)*

## Technical Approach
1. **Modular Configuration (`V2Feature::Senescence`, slug `senescence`):**
   - Under `v2.senescence` (default `enabled = true` on `field-ecology-v2`, cleanly disabled via `v2.senescence.enabled = false` or `--disable senescence` → exact baseline `c_basal`!):
     - `enabled: bool`
     - `scale_seconds: f64` (`τ_sen > 0.0`, finite; default `30.0 s` = `960` ticks at `Δt = 1/32 s`)
     - `maximum_multiplier: f64` (`M_max >= 1.0`, finite; default `64.0` — **`AUDIT-1` overflow guard** for endurance runs!).
   - Reject `scale_seconds <= 0.0`, non-finite values, or `maximum_multiplier < 1.0` in `validate.rs`.
2. **Maintenance Formula (`crates/flife-engine/src/costs.rs`, `crates/flife-field/src/settle.rs`, `crates/flife-engine/src/world/settle.rs`):**
   - Compute exact organism age `age_s = flife_core::clock::age_seconds(birth_tick, current_tick, step)` from integer `Tick` difference (never F32 clock accumulation!).
   - When `senescence.enabled`:
     $$m_{\text{age}} = 1.0 + \min\!\left(\left(\frac{\text{age}_s}{\tau_{\text{sen}}}\right)^2,\; M_{\max} - 1.0\right), \qquad c_{\text{basal,eff}} = c_{\text{basal}} \cdot m_{\text{age}}$$
   - Debit `c_basal_eff * Δt` through existing `Flow::Maintenance` in `EnergyBudget::pay` (`INV-01`/`INV-03`/`INV-05` strictly unchanged!).
3. **Clean Metal Interface (`crates/flife-field/src/settle.rs`, `crates/flife-backend-metal/src/motion.rs`, `motion.metal`):**
   - Add `pub basal_multiplier: f64` (`1.0` when `senescence` is disabled or on `v1`) directly on `MotionOrganism`, computing `m_age` once on host in `world/settle.rs`.
   - In `motion.metal:163`, multiply `basal = d_mul(d_mul(seconds, m_load(params, 3u)), m_load(organism, M_BASAL_MULT))` (fast-path identical to baseline when `basal_multiplier == 1.0`!). Guarantees 100% bit-exact CPU/Metal parity with minimal shader diff and zero redundant age math on GPU!

## Success Criteria
- `--disable senescence` / `enabled = false` matches baseline `costs.rs` **bit-for-bit**.
- Validation rejects `scale_seconds <= 0.0`, `NaN`, and `maximum_multiplier < 1.0`.
- With `τ_sen = 30 s`, young organisms (`age < 3 s`) pay `< 1%` extra basal maintenance (zero tick-0 founder cliff!), while aged adults (`age > 60 s`) pay `5×`, continuously turning over slots.
- CPU and Metal `motion.metal` match bit-for-bit; `C.8` cancel and checkpoint round-trip match bit-for-bit; `INV-03` residual `< 1e-5`.

## Test Plan & E2E Verification
- **Known-answer & negative unit tests (`flife-core`, `flife-engine::costs`):**
  - `senescence_exact_formula_and_overflow_clamp`: verify exact `Flow::Maintenance` debit at `age = 0, τ_sen/2, τ_sen, 2 τ_sen, 1e6 τ_sen` (confirming `M_max` clamp prevents Inf/NaN).
  - `senescence_invalid_config_rejected`: verify `scale_seconds <= 0.0`, `NaN`, or `maximum_multiplier < 1.0` fail `validate()`.
  - `senescence_disabled_matches_baseline_bit_exact`: assert bit-identical settlement when disabled.
  - `senescence_exhaustion_reports_maintenance_stage`: verify aged organism exhausting on senescence dies cleanly at `BudgetStage::Maintenance` with exact `INV-03` closure.
- **Metal parity & Invariant tests (`flife-backend-metal`, `flife-engine`):**
  - `metal_settle_senescence_bit_exact_with_cpu`: compare CPU vs Metal maintenance outcomes across 1,024 organisms spanning ages `0..500 s`.
  - `senescence_c8_cancel_and_checkpoint_roundtrip`: verify cancellation and checkpoint resume bit-exactness.
- **E2E test (`flife-engine`):**
  - `e2e_senescence_increases_generational_turnover`: 2,048 ticks (`64²`) with `senescence` enabled vs `--disable senescence`, logging mean generation, max age, births committed/refused ratio, and `INV-03` residual; assert higher mean generation and bounded max age.
acceptance_criteria: v2.senescence (V2Feature::Senescence, slug 'senescence') applies exact quadratic Gompertz basal multiplier m_age = 1 + min((age_s / tau_sen)^2, M_max - 1) from integer Tick age_seconds, passed as basal_multiplier: f64 on MotionOrganism (2 d_mul lines in motion.metal); validate.rs rejects scale_seconds <= 0, NaN, or maximum_multiplier < 1.0; --disable senescence matches baseline bit-for-bit; CPU & Metal match bit-for-bit; C.8 cancel, checkpoint round-trip & generational-turnover E2E pass with INV-03 residual < 1e-5.
close_reason: Verified green centrally on Mac (CPU + Apple Silicon Metal GPU): flife-field 94/94 PASS, flife-engine v2_senescence 6/6 PASS (formula/overflow, invalid config, maintenance exhaustion, disabled bit-exact, C.8/checkpoint v3, E2E turnover), flife-backend-metal motion 4/4 PASS (metal_v2_senescence_and_so2_motor_bit_exact_and_so2_equivariant bit-exact on Metal GPU), 0 clippy warnings, 0 UBS criticals.
